1704 Walker Place Boulevard
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$235,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,481 SF, MLS# 575695

This beautiful home in the Walker Place neighborhood is available and priced to sell. With 3BR/2BA and 1481 sq. ft., you will have plenty of room for your family. This home is brick on all four sides.  The view from the covered patio is spectacular. Relax after a long day on your patio, or enjoy the jetted tub in the master bath. The master bath has a dual vanity, and very large his and hers closets.  The large master bedroom is big enough for a king sized bed and other furniture. The two minor bedrooms are located on the opposite end of the home, and are a good size for children’s bedrooms. The kitchen is open to the family room, and boasts an island and a pantry. This home is zoned for Martin Walker Elementary which is one of 5 campuses in Copperas Cove to be named in US News and World Report as being in the “Best Elementary School” rankings.  Call today to see this home soon!

2 full bath
